selection.rule: Pick the method with the lowest pooled WAPE over the 7 expanding-window dev folds. Accept it only if its paired per-SKU-day absolute error minus M1 seasonal naive has a 95% block-bootstrap interval (calendar-day blocks) entirely below 0, i.e. it is reliably better. Otherwise record "no reliable improvement" and keep FORECAST_ENGINE = velocity. No preset, window or parameter is changed after these numbers are seen.
